scene1.title: Scene 1: Architecture Comparison
scene1.description:
Explore the fundamental differences between centralized and decentralized systems.
Walk through the Bank City and Blockchain City to understand how trust and control are distributed.

legend.title: Legend:
legend.bank: Bank City: Traditional centralized system with a central authority managing all transactions.
legend.blockchain: Blockchain City: Decentralized network where trust is distributed across many nodes.
legend.vr: VR: Use controller ray + trigger to switch cities and explore.

scene2.title: Scene 2: Block Integrity Lab
scene2.description:
Inspect block fields, tamper one transaction, and watch downstream blocks fail.
Then remint to restore chain integrity.

tutorial.title: Guided Tutorial
steps: Select a non-genesis block (#1 and above).
Edit TX and apply tamper to break the chain.
Select the first broken block to inspect the mismatch.
Recover integrity with Remint Chain or Reset Chain.

legend.title: Legend:
legend.description:
Green blocks are valid, red blocks are invalid.
Connectors turn red where chain linkage is broken.
VR: Use controller ray + trigger to select blocks and press panel controls.

scene3.title: Scene 3: Cryptographic Keys
scene3.description:
Three-step verification: key format, ownership, signature.
Challenge-response uses a rotating nonce and derived signature.

legend.title: Legend:
legend.description:
Green means transaction approved and vault unlocks.
Red means access denied due to invalid private key.
VR: Use controller ray + trigger on panel buttons and actor terminals.

scene4.title: Scene 4: Consensus Arena
scene4.description:
Compare Proof of Work and Proof of Stake in one arena.
PoW is slower and energy-heavy, PoS picks validators by stake and finalizes faster.

panels.legendDescription:
Green means block accepted, red means consensus failed.
In PoW winner is weighted by hash power; in PoS by validator stake and can be slashed.
Partition mode can create fork pressure and quorum failures.
panels.legendVrText: Use controller ray + trigger on panel buttons or validator nodes.

legend.title: Legend:
legend.description:
Blue nodes are validators, green are proposers.
Yellow connections show active consensus communication.
VR: Use controller ray + trigger to interact with nodes and controls.
